description: A designer dissociative that drops you into the static between channels.

effects.comeon_message: You take it and stand still, waiting for it to work.

events.text: [trip]The channel-hold slips. The room dissolves into blue snow and a low, patient hum.[/trip]
[trip]The static sea hums your name and you feel it in your back teeth.[/trip]
[trip]A memory swims past wearing someone else's face. It nods at you.[/trip]
[trip]An advertisement for a product that doesn't exist plays across the whole sky.[/trip]
[trip]You wade deeper. The blue closes over your knees, your chest, your reasons for leaving.[/trip]
[trip]The signal starts to resolve. Somewhere above the static, a channel is trying to find you again.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Your mind goes quiet and blank.

overdose.message: You go blank and don't come back.

phases.comedown_message: Your senses come back, too loud.
phases.end_message: You're back to normal. It took longer than it should have.

effects.take_line: You dose {name} and wait for the signal to drop.

withdrawal.message: Everything is too bright and too sharp. You miss feeling blank.

stages.easing: It fades to a hiss you can work through.
stages.onset: The calm blue quiet switches off and the noise comes back, loud.
stages.peak: There's no quiet left anywhere. Every surface in the room seems to be saying something.
stages.rising: Everything feels like it's talking, and all of it's aimed at you.
stages.tail: You're back to normal. Now and then you listen for the quiet that isn't there.

name: dead air
